profile.summary: La Cheim is a nonprofit that provides education and mental health services to children, teens and adults in Alameda and Contra Costa counties. Its programs include a non-public school, a short-term residential treatment program for adolescents, a community-based youth program, and a day treatment and outpatient program for adults.
